label: fresh leave-one-out retraining (deletion reference)
note: the reference Delta_retrain is measured against

transformation_success.scope: transformation targets only; refusal controls are reported beside them and never inside the headline

coverage.note: null, never a vacuous 1.0, when the set has no sibling control (unique-branch identities)

candidate_validity.semantics: score SUM without a termination event, not a literal probability mass; see scoring_limitation

oracle_distances.metric: gated L2 over the frozen candidate vocabulary; positive Delta_retrain = closer to the fresh MATCHED retraining reference than to the fresh leave-one-out reference
oracle_distances.scope: transformation targets only; refusal controls never contribute to this distance
